notes.title: Better Bots Update is LIVE
notes.notes:
Better Bots is all about better Workerbots and efficiency!

Introducing the Better Bots Update

We've dedicate several weeks to quality of life improvements and bug fixes and we are now culminating those efforts in the Better Bots Update to showcase it all and shift gears into finalising the next region. 


Workerbot Hardpoint Pickup

The biggest improvement introduced in this update is the ability to pick Workerbots up onto your Hardpoint. This makes dropping workers up on ledges or down into valley much easier and pairs incredibly well with the Catapults and Crushers. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/28790b729686d445a8ba3133adfb1389a09e6a50.gif"]

It also makes it possible to flip workers back onto their wheel without the need for a gravity tether. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/2d7502a66ea841873015adc5bb71235f305a414f.gif"]

Workerbot Dispatch

It is now possible to use the delivery upgrade to dispatch Workerbots. You can hold and drag a line to designate a path for them to follow knowing they will vacuum up chips along the way or you can just request they come to you so that you can pick them up.   

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/f57f56db0caf6d66ab9f9b717e834942951f03ac.gif"]



Workerbot Order Assignment

Workers now choose orders based on proximity so you will see less of them transiting aimlessly ignoring things right next to them that could have been taken. 

Workers now also take over jobs from other workers if they became available and are much closer to the task. This makes loading Crushers and Catapults much more efficient as bots don't head back to the shuttle the moment they drop their cargo, but rather look around and see if they can take work from one of their colleagues who is headed here but still far away. 

We have also improved the loading interactions for the Crane and Catapult and the Crusher has been added to the transit network so now when you happen to block the path to the shuttle when placing the Crusher the workers will still see it as a valid connection and drop resources there correctly. 


New Equipment - Toolbox

We have also added a new piece of equipment for you to bring with you to the asteroid - the Toolbox. This box caries copies of all your Commandbot Tools and allows you to re-configure you bot out in the field the same way you would if you were on the shuttle. Now you can grab a blaster and put away your scanner whenever you need. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/5daacee27511724e725ed8e3c0c79aa9ff618977.gif"]


Other Quality of life improvements 

We have overhauled the Hardpoint interface to make it easier to load and unload your equipment between the Shuttle and Commandbot  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/5024db7c417fa02244f0594f1831c8bc19fd7bde.gif"]

The return to station popup now recognises the region you are in chooses the corresponding station as the default, also displaying the distances to the other station choices. 

The Q Radial now has a BACK option located in the center allowing you to better navigate the radial menus. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/885efc8783f4005a1b810b5b47fd12d9c77cd625.gif"]

Cube Credit values are now presented in both the Tooltip and Storage view to give you a better idea of the value of each resource you encounter. 

The asteroids now travel in both directions through your mining claim, not just one like before. 

We have also added a suite of debug / support options for getting your bots unstuck [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/daa6f82fcf4f419ec2bfd56094b983893878f480.gif"]


Daily Deal! Special Bundles! More Cool Games!

In celebration of the update, starting at 10AM PST on 7/28/2025 we're running a Daily Deal with a discount of 20%. We have also teamed up with a few of our friends to hold a special "Four Galaxies" sci-fi extravaganza! We're bundling with three other sci-fi games that have major releases today: Star Valor with its new Base Building DLC, Reality Break with its Ascension Update, and last but not least, Star Vortex which is launching today into Early Access! All games are available bundled with each other for extra discounts, so there's a ton of cool new stuff for you to check out!!



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/833360/Star_Valor/"][/dynamiclink]

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1473060/Reality_Break/"][/dynamiclink]

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2098160/Star_Vortex/"][/dynamiclink]

What's next?  

We are now shifting gears to focus more on the upcoming Content Update that will take players to the next region with new asteroid classes, a whole new station and new resource types to discover.     

Thanks again for following along! Cube Corp wishes you a prosperous day!   

-hube

notes.title: Black Tidal Update is Live
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce the the Black Tidal update is now live. A whole new region with 4 new asteroid classes, all new resources with a focus on liquids, which can now be harvested using the Liquid Pump. Lets take a look at everything this update has in store!

New Region - New Corporation - New Resources - New Asteroid Classes

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/7d68c6782b7f57b175e7608ae0104c31e1d3e4d2.gif"]

As you explore you will encounter some new liquids but beware - some of them may not be so friendly!


New Blueprint - The Liquid Pump


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/bd2c0ee18a5fec54aff84e335ded32670ffbe23b.gif"]

Place it next to any body of water, toss the hose into the liquid and just watch it slowly package up the liquids into nice compact containers ready for transit. Once a liquid body is drained you can start building and exploring the empty basin!



New Blueprint - The Resource Catapult



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/4611206ee5a9c5ff681d82ba436f9c778bbe5ea3.gif"]


This new piece of equipment can help you optimise resource routes, cross chasms and even shoot up hills to get resources out of a gorge. 



Level 3 Pirates


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/ee570bb5258e66470af26468ba3f86ee15f73b99.gif"]

You will now encounter pre-built pirate defences on Asteroids with 💀💀💀 Pirate Activity. Make sure you clear the asteroid before sending your workerbots out!




New Manufacturing Machine - The Clarifier + Larger Manufacturing Bay

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/40f421cad22dadf402af9ae30d79f16d2a610c92.gif"]

You can now operate more machines in various configurations with 4 manufacturing slots and make use of the new Clarifier which can help split certain resources down into two outputs. 


New Command Bot Modifications

Ultrawide support


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/f341dfbc26d8eddad978686b3e82c6cde6b12188.png"]

Help / Debug Support Hub

Congratulations! you made it to the end of this message! We hope you enjoy the update. Thanks for joining us on this Early Access ride. Second Content Update

The Black Tidal Update is here - we have a new region! This Cube Corp subsidiary is focused on liquid resources which you will find in abundance on asteroids in the new region. 


 Liquid Pump Blueprint

Liquid pools have gone through an overhaul. On top of visual updates liquids will impact your speed, change the audio and some will have interesting properties for you to discover. notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello! We have entered May and are working hard to get the Black Tidal region for you all this month! 

FIrst lets do a rundown of the news

The Roadmap has been updated
You can check that out here

We're launching an Astronomics Wiki on wiki.gg
Efforts spearheaded by Alikimoko and a group of great folks he has gathered are about to yield some incredible results as we welcome the official Astronomics wiki. It has been a tremendous endeavour and we've been helping as best we can. Thank you to everyone who contributed to this effort, the folks at wiki.gg and especially to Alikimoko who has done the bulk of the heavy lifting. Very exciting to see this go live sometime in May. 

March Update Launched last month
The post about the March update never got more than some patch notes so here's a rundown of some of the new equipment that has been introduced to the game at the end of March!

The Gravity Well
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/ac44310747bfee4da0f459abbb51caa895517a4f.gif
A contraption that lets you feed matter into a tiny black hole to then exert a counter force to the asteroid causing it to stop and give you more time to mine resources!

The Forcefield
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/8f7fb5df8a54966e6930cc125691383dd1160788.gif
A portable piece of equipment that produces a defensive shield that will block pirate bullets and prevent pirate pods from landing inside! But beware, the pirates can still walk in, just like you and the workerbots can. 

The Portable Battery
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/b884e2e9f8cc68992a52867e862eba8090679fa8.gif
A portable battery that allows you to charge out in the field. Great when paired with the workerbot delivery system. Forget going back to the shuttle - take some extra juice with you. 

The Black Tidal Update
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795107/28ec0ded6b08c9b4e4f32f669023ac04d88b2d81.gif
Finally a sneak peek at the Black Tidal Content we are working on for this month! The Liquid Pumps - build these near bodies of liquid and dunk the hose to start pumping! Once pools are drained you can proceed to extract the resources within! 

We are still working to address some of the more urgent bugs you have reported, and improve the Manufacturing experience before this update goes out - look for those in the coming days. 

We've also got some grass shader improvements that will hopefully be improving the performance, especially at higher resolutions, when the May update goes live! 

Thanks for making it all the way to the end! Cheers! 

-hube

notes.title: Version 0.73.10 - Crane Optimization
notes.notes:
We know everyone is waiting on manufacturing fixes and they are underway, but yesterday's Crane pathfinding fixes also introduces some heavy calculations that were slowing down the game when 6+ cranes were placed on an asteroid and the transit possibility space became complicated to calculate. Happy to report that we've been able to solve this problem! 


 Fix Mining Laser Level 2 not showing Icon in bottom right corner when selected
 Info Overlay displays underground deposits
 Info Overlay displays additional button mapping
 Performance improvement to the crane pathfinding calculation
 Repeat fix to the resolution resetting on load problem - resolution should now remain after being set!


CUBE CORP wishes you a prosperous day!
-hube

notes.title: Version 0.73.8 - New options to slow asteroids and disable pirates
notes.notes:
Hello! We have heard the response from the forums and discord and have implemented some new Gameplay Settings to let you enjoy Astronomics at your own pace!


 Added “Asteroid Time” multiplier to Gameplay Setting - you can now slow down asteroids up to 10x
 Added toggle to “Disable Pirates” in Gameplay Settings
 Shortened hyperjumps back to station down to 5 seconds to respect player’s time. (Jumps to asteroid remain 30 seconds as they are a loading screen for the asteroid generator. Remember that you are free to exit the map view and walk about the cabin during transit. Go set Manufacturing, talk to CUBO, look at Contracts, examine your Knowledge Base or grab a Coffee)
 Small fix to Workerbot pathing that will help with Crane choice distribution - still working on this but already improved
 Further fix to Video Codecs - videos now play on Steam Deck and no users should require to use the _novideo branch
 Resolution once set should no longer re-vert on reload / nap


Improving manufacturing times is next on our list! Look out for that one soon!

CUBE CORP wishes you a prosperous day!
-hube

notes.title: Version 0.73.7 - Hotfixes including Video Codec issue
notes.notes:
I'm back with another set of hotfixes. Thank you for reporting the issues and being patient with us as we address them. 


 Safeguard added to keep Command Bot on shuttle after takeoff
 Prior save file now backed up when game saves to aid recovery if anything goes wrong
 Added system to prevent joystick drift affecting player aim (plug all the HOTAS and joysticks back in and let me know if there are still any issues with input)
 Sales Terminal was incorrectly checking the Contracts Tab when selling resource. Now it is actually checking the station you are at. All sales will get attributed to contracts at the station you are visiting.
 The trigger volume past the Shuttle Launch doors has been resized to fill the entire space, so you can’t end up in that closet without the prompt to launch the expedition. 
 Mining laser level 1 should show purchased even after it is replaced by Mining Laser Level 2
 Potentially solved issue with black screen when starting game. Anyone playing on the _novideo beta branch can now return to the main branch and should be fine! Please report if that is not the case. The _novideo branch continues to be updated until we have more certainty that missing video codec problems are resolved for you all.
 

CUBE CORP wishes you another prosperous day! 
-hube
